objective: Normalize the entire standalone Cortex application into a project-agnostic local AI/agent mainframe before deeper indexing, auditing, assimilation and automation work.

normalization_domains.name: Executable and product identity
targets: apps/cortex is canonical CLI
apps/cortex_desktop is canonical desktop
apps/open2d_cortex remains compatibility-only until callers migrate
Cortex version/pass identity becomes independent from Open2D handoff identity

normalization_domains.name: Crate authority and dependency direction
targets: Create/migrate generic cortex_protocol, cortex_http, cortex_rpc
Create/migrate generic cortex_process, cortex_image, cortex_capture
Create/migrate generic cortex_tools and cortex_core
Create/migrate generic cortex_provider_lmstudio and cortex_provider_comfyui
Merge open2d_cortex_workspace into cortex_workspace then retire compatibility crate
Resolve open2d_cortex_memory into cortex_memory/cortex_vault responsibilities
Generic cortex_* crates must not depend on transitional open2d_cortex_* crates after closure

normalization_domains.name: Workspace identity and state ownership
targets: Persistent WorkspaceId independent of current filesystem path
Global Cortex-owned state under CORTEX_HOME/user-local storage
Known-path history for moved repositories
Portable project-local .cortex state only by explicit policy
Open2D historical .open2d/cortex compatibility retained through adapter/migration

normalization_domains.name: Jobs, scheduling and event stream
targets: One cortex_jobs authority for long operations
Queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled lifecycle
Progress, logs, result and error payloads
One Cortex event stream for workspace, context, vault, build, tool, artifact and approval events
Desktop/CLI/tools consume the same job state rather than bespoke blocking operations

normalization_domains.name: Context, Vault and memory separation
targets: cortex_workspace owns paths, detection, safe enumeration and workspace profile
cortex_context owns file fingerprints, incremental index, language/symbol/dependency discovery and change sets
cortex_vault owns chunks, retrieval, lexical/embedding indexes and provenance
cortex_memory owns durable user/project memories only if it remains a distinct concept
No indexing intelligence catch-all inside cortex_workspace

normalization_domains.name: Tool catalog, permissions and execution policy
targets: cortex_tools becomes generic canonical ToolBroker/catalog authority
Tool metadata declares read/write/process/network/destructive/credential/system capabilities
One cortex_permissions policy engine gates all risky execution
Human approval and transaction boundaries are shared across desktop/CLI/RPC
Open2D-specific tools live behind the Open2D adapter

normalization_domains.name: Provider and model routing
targets: Generic provider trait/capability registry
LM Studio and ComfyUI renamed/migrated out of open2d_cortex_*
Provider discovery, health, model capability and endpoint settings share one contract
No machine-specific endpoint in source
Future local providers can plug in without Open2D dependencies

normalization_domains.name: RPC, protocol, service and client
targets: Generic cortex_protocol and cortex_rpc are the sole wire authority
Protocol versioning and capability negotiation
Local authentication/token lifecycle separated from project state
cortex_service and cortex_client depend only on generic protocol/RPC
Open2D integration uses adapter RPC contracts rather than defining Cortex wire primitives

normalization_domains.name: Desktop shell and UX authority
targets: One desktop view-model/controller authority
Workspace manager, conversations, context, changes, terminal/build, logs, tasks, artifacts, Vault and settings share canonical state
Long operations are non-blocking and event-driven
No duplicated desktop vs CLI business logic
Native desktop remains project-agnostic

normalization_domains.name: CLI, VS Code bridge and external clients
targets: CLI becomes a thin client/orchestration surface over canonical services
VS Code bridge consumes generic Cortex protocol/client APIs
Compatibility command aliases may remain but user-facing wording becomes Cortex-first
External clients do not depend on Open2D-named protocol crates

normalization_domains.name: Transactions, review, source editing and rollback
targets: One transaction authority for source modifications
Unified diff/review representation
Checkpoint/rollback and artifact lineage
Tool writes cannot bypass transaction/permission policy when policy requires review
Cross-project migration work preserves provenance

normalization_domains.name: Logs, diagnostics, artifacts and crash recovery
targets: One session/job logging contract
Structured diagnostic events plus human-readable logs
Secret-safe debug bundle policy
Artifact registry with producer/job/workspace lineage
Crash recovery for interrupted transactions/jobs

normalization_domains.name: Plugins and adapters
targets: Plugin capabilities and permissions declared explicitly
Adapters are integrations, not core authorities
Open2D adapter remains first-class but optional
Git remains generic adapter
Future PCC integration is an external operational adapter/client, not Cortex core ownership

normalization_domains.name: Configuration, schemas and migrations
targets: Schema versions for registry/settings/context/vault/protocol/tool catalog
Forward migration and rollback policy
No silent incompatible state rewrites
Cortex schema/version identity separated from Open2D pass naming

normalization_domains.name: Testing and certification
targets: Generic Cortex certification independent of Open2D project availability
Adapter-specific certification layered on top
Workspace move/reconnect tests
Permission denial/approval tests
Job cancellation/recovery tests
Protocol compatibility tests
State migration tests
Clippy -D warnings remains required

normalization_domains.name: Security and privacy boundaries
targets: Local-first by default
Explicit external-network permission
Secrets never enter source refresh/debug bundles
Workspace path safety and symlink/reparse-point policy
Command/process allowlists and approval policy
Provider credentials/endpoints remain settings-owned

normalization_domains.name: Build, packaging and standalone distribution
targets: Cortex can build/package independently of Open2D Foundry
Open2D handoff system may continue transporting Cortex development patches during co-development
Standalone installer/update channel is a later product concern
Compatibility launcher retirement does not affect standalone Cortex packaging

normalization_domains.name: Cross-project audit and assimilation readiness
targets: Capability inventory schema
Source provenance and lineage
Compare two or more attached projects
Classify KEEP/PORT/COMPARE/SUPERSEDED
Never blindly merge older implementations
Prepare specifically for advanced older Open2D source comparison after normalization

state_compatibility_debt: Legacy .cortex and .open2d/cortex remain migration/portable compatibility paths only.

execution_order: R051N1 dependency/authority closure map + generic protocol/http/rpc foundation
R051N2 generic tools/core boundary and Open2D adapter extraction
R051N3 workspace identity + global state migration framework
R051N5 cortex_context extraction and Vault/memory responsibility split
R051D_REBASED incremental context indexer on normalized jobs/context stack
R051F cross-project comparison and deliberate assimilation
feature_freeze_policy: Do not deepen transitional Cortex/Open2D coupling while R051N is active. Bug fixes and certification fixes remain allowed. Feature work resumes on normalized authorities.

completed_passes.summary: Generic protocol/HTTP/RPC authorities and thin facades.
Generic cortex_core/cortex_tools ownership and CLI migration.
Open2D runtime tools extracted as adapter ToolExtension.
Persistent WorkspaceId/global state and legacy migration.
Unified jobs and event stream authority.
Schemas, security, diagnostics, artifact lineage and final authority certification closure.

next_pass.scope: Apply full R051N train, run Cortex checkpoint, debug any compile/test/clippy issues, then certify normalization complete.
